prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high quality dark mythic naturalistic fantasy creature DESIGN CONTACT SHEET for Witch, species mole. SIX clearly separated equal panels in THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS. Column A, B, C are THREE DISTINCT concepts below. TOP ROW: low near-ground heroic environmental view, whole giant clearly framed. BOTTOM ROW: SAME A/B/C designs respectively at actual-game-camera approximation: looking down29.79degrees, body turned34.38degrees toward camera from side, affine/isometric-looking, whole creature visible. No lettering, no labels, no UI. Strong coherent silhouettes, richly tactile fur/weathered materials, moonlit forest palette with selective magic light.
EVERY ONE OF SIX PANELS must show a small modern young adult WITCH standing on ground BESIDE giant: pointed floppy olive hat, headphones, jeans, sneakers, broom, warm lantern. Also several actual FOREST TREES at same ground plane around giant as unmistakable scale rulers. Creature anatomical height is COLOSSAL, above surrounding mature treetops, about20times its species baby height as design intent. Witch is tiny beside it; never same-size character portrait, never merely ordinary animal. Trees have discernible trunks/crowns. Atmospheric depth for distant body, massive heavy landform wear, ancient ecology. Don't hide animal face beneath vegetation or effects. Scale cues are mandatory in bottom game-camera row too. Distinct signatures, not common royal crown uniform.
Area story from actual source: Fern forest: leaf litter, moss, ferns, mossy birches, oaks and rowans..
Column A: Deep Delver: enormous earless European mole low velvet cylinder/pink nose/tiny eyes, vast OUTWARD shovel palms with ivory worn claws split mossy ground into geological terraces, fern/birch roots trail flank, carved tunnel offerings on palms.
Column B: Root Listener: colossal mole with tiny eyes/no external ears/pink snout, rootlike copper sensory whiskers descend through earth and glow like underground river map, velvet body eroded like rounded basalt, huge outward palms, nurse moss/fern garden in old scars.
Column C: MAXIMUM FANTASY Architect Below: mountain-sized recognisable MOLE, earless velvet low tube, pink pointed nose and enormous lateral shovel palms; hands lift great curved layers of earth like pages of geological time, living forests on those lifted strata, amber-lit tunnel-cathedral cross-sections visible within claw furrows; shoulder moss/stone strata and votive carvings. Four limbs, not humanoid hands.
Species must be identifiable at a glance from anatomy, not labels. No extra legs or fused witch/animal. Echo concept-specific anatomy/material/signature faithfully between top and bottom rows. Old/powerful/revered not cute baby. This is concept art, not runtime screenshot; no numerical scale labels.
